document_status: SYNTHETIC - fictional city, created for testing only; not a real client document
labelling_note: Small, manually annotated dataset. Ground truth is limited to requirements and gaps explicitly present in the synthetic RFP. It is not a representative benchmark and metrics do not generalize.

functional_requirements.canonical: Applicants can create an account, submit a permit application online, and save a draft.
aliases: Online permit application submission with draft saving
Applicant account creation and saved draft applications

functional_requirements.canonical: Support at least six permit types at launch: residential renovation, fence, signage, food service, short-term rental and special event.
aliases: Six permit types supported at launch
Multiple permit categories including renovation, fence, signage, food service, rental and events

functional_requirements.canonical: Applicants upload supporting documents in PDF, PNG or JPEG format with a 10 MB per-file limit.
aliases: Document upload of PDF PNG JPEG files up to 10MB
File attachment validation and size limit

functional_requirements.canonical: Calculate and collect permit fees online through the City's existing Stripe merchant account and email a receipt automatically.
aliases: Online fee payment via Stripe with automatic email receipt
Permit fee calculation and payment collection

functional_requirements.canonical: Send email and SMS notifications when an application is received, when information is requested, and when a decision is issued.
aliases: Applicant notifications for application status changes

functional_requirements.canonical: Provide City staff a review dashboard with the queue, application details, uploaded documents and a complete audit history of status changes.
aliases: Staff review dashboard with queue and audit history
Permit reviewer dashboard displaying applications and documents

functional_requirements.canonical: Support five roles: applicant, intake clerk, permit reviewer, supervisor and system administrator.
aliases: Five user roles with role-based access
Applicant clerk reviewer supervisor administrator roles

functional_requirements.canonical: Supervisors can reassign applications and export a monthly PDF report.
aliases: Application reassignment and monthly PDF reporting
Supervisor workload reassignment and report export

functional_requirements.canonical: The public can search approved permits by address, permit type and date.
aliases: Public permit search by address type and date

functional_requirements.canonical: Retain all application records and audit logs for seven years.
aliases: Seven-year record and audit log retention
Retention of permit records for 7 years

functional_requirements.canonical: Applicants can request an inspection online and view inspection results.
aliases: Online inspection request and result viewing
Inspection scheduling and results in the portal

functional_requirements.canonical: Provide a user-friendly interface and reasonable response times for all pages.
aliases: User-friendly interface with reasonable page response times

non_functional_requirements.canonical: Public portal availability of 99.9 percent measured monthly, excluding scheduled maintenance.
Support 1,000 concurrent users during peak periods.
Public-facing portal conforms to WCAG 2.1 Level AA.
aliases: Accessibility standard WCAG 2.1 AA for public pages

non_functional_requirements.canonical: Encrypt all data in transit and at rest.
aliases: Data encryption in transit and at rest
Encryption of stored and transmitted permit data

non_functional_requirements.canonical: Collect only the personal information necessary for permits and publish a privacy notice.
aliases: Data minimization and published privacy notice
Privacy notice and limited PII collection

non_functional_requirements.canonical: Each page loads in under two seconds for 95 percent of requests; another section states all pages must respond within five seconds.
aliases: Page load performance under 2 seconds and 5 second response target
Performance requirement for page response times

non_functional_requirements.canonical: Provide source code, deployment documentation and administrator training at handover.
aliases: Source code and deployment documentation handover

technical_requirements.canonical: Integrate with Tyler Munis ERP for permit fee posting and general ledger reconciliation.
aliases: Tyler Munis ERP integration for fees and general ledger

technical_requirements.canonical: City staff single sign-on through Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD); public applicants use local accounts.
aliases: Microsoft Entra ID Azure AD SSO for staff

technical_requirements.canonical: Prefer AWS deployment in the us-east-1 region.
PostgreSQL is familiar and acceptable, but no database is mandated.
React frontend is preferred but not required.
Send SMS through a commercial messaging provider; provider not selected.
aliases: Commercial SMS provider required and undecided
SMS gateway integration with unspecified provider

technical_requirements.canonical: Provide a disaster recovery plan, but RTO and RPO are not defined.
aliases: Disaster recovery plan required with undefined RTO RPO
DR plan with recovery objectives not specified

missing_information.canonical: Data migration inventory, record count and data quality
aliases: Current database inventory and record count

missing_information.canonical: Disaster recovery recovery time and recovery point objectives (RTO/RPO)
Incident response service level and support hours
aliases: Support SLA and incident response times
Which SMS gateway or messaging provider

ambiguities.canonical: Concurrent user target conflicts: 500 users in one statement and 1,000 during peak in another.
Performance target conflicts: page load under two seconds versus all pages responding within five seconds.
Launch scope conflicts: all functionality required at launch versus phased launch with inspections and search in Q4.
Reasonable response times and user-friendly interface are undefined and unmeasurable.
Appropriate security practices is undefined and not testable.

risks.canonical: ERP integration uncertainty due to missing Tyler Munis API details.
Payment card compliance and finance review risk for the Stripe integration.
Legacy data migration quality and inventory risk.
Schedule risk from conflicting launch scope and deadlines.
Accessibility compliance and testing ownership risk.
